_doc: The workspace declared as data: what cannot be measured about each unit (CODE_STANDARD section 0).
Membership is measured, not listed here: a folder holding .git belongs (check_temp_artifacts.py).
cascade: the release order push.ps1 walks; blendertk shares mayatk's tier, after it and before tentacle.

units: every front door with an AGENTS.md, in root dispatch-table order. release is cascade, standalone (own publish.yml) or none; role product marks a unit no other package may import (check_layers.py): tentacle, and extapps. twin names the unit's mirror in another host (mayatk and blendertk), declared on one side; the two may name each other (check_layers.py, names).

line_budget: the ceiling on the ecosystem set's source lines -- non-blank lines of the .py files a release would commit, outside test/ (check_context_budget.py counts them; push.ps1 refuses a release past it). Set 2026-10-26 to the count then; raised or lowered as docs/CONTEXT_BUDGET.md says.
Restatements (root AGENTS.md dispatch table, CI sibling lists) are checked by scripts/sync_workspace.py --check.

packs: the agent-instruction packs (m3trik/agents/packs) a unit vendors; the top-level list is the workspace root's, imported once. sync_workspace.py writes and checks them (pythontk's AgentInstructions).

units.domain: Generic Qt UI library; no DCC/app logic
Maya 2025+ host library; each tool's Maya API half
Blender 4.x+ host library, mirrors mayatk; each tool's Blender API half
The product: the launcher, every tool's panel and Slots class
Standalone apps: each host-free app's engine, panel and Slots class
